name: PlayerEngine
description: Autonomous player-agent engine: pathfinding, world interaction, inventory and task planning for a program-controlled player. A NeoVetta fork of Goodbird-git/PlayerEngine, which builds on Baritone for pathfinding. Bundled inside AI Companion and not intended to be installed on its own.
contributors: The Baritone authors — pathfinding and automation layer (LGPL-3.0)
The AltoClef authors — task and command framework (MIT)
